name: Mokkify Self-Hosted API Mock Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted REST API mocking application with response templates, OpenAPI import, request logs, delays, relay hooks, API keys and MCP integration; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Node.js >=20.17, pnpm 10, SQLite storage and server/compute resources; hosted infrastructure and outbound relay services are not included. Set a unique JWT_SECRET and protect admin/API/MCP endpoints before exposing publicly. Upstream demo credentials are not safe production credentials.
